name: Alaska
fired: within 3 working days after the day of termination
laid_off: within 3 working days after the day of termination
quit: the next regular payday at least 3 days after the employer received notice
late_penalty: the regular wage from the time of demand to the time of payment, or for 90 working days, whichever is less

name: Arizona
fired: within 7 working days or by the end of the next regular pay period, whichever is sooner
laid_off: within 7 working days or by the end of the next regular pay period, whichever is sooner
quit: by the regular payday for the pay period in which the termination occurred
late_penalty: in a civil action, treble the unpaid wages

name: Colorado
fired: immediately
laid_off: immediately
quit: by the next regular payday

name: Connecticut
fired: by the next business day
laid_off: by the next regular payday
quit: by the next regular payday
late_penalty: in a civil action, twice the full amount of the wages

name: Delaware
fired: on the later of the next regular payday and 3 business days after the last day worked
laid_off: on the later of the next regular payday and 3 business days after the last day worked
quit: on the later of the next regular payday and 3 business days after the last day worked
late_penalty: liquidated damages of the lower of 10% of the unpaid wages for each day (except Sundays and legal holidays) the failure continues, or an amount equal to the unpaid wages

name: District of Columbia
fired: by the next working day
laid_off: by the next working day
quit: by the next regular payday or within 7 days, whichever is earlier
late_penalty: liquidated damages of 10% of the unpaid wages for each working day the failure continues, or treble the unpaid wages, whichever is smaller

name: Idaho
fired: by the next regular payday or within 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded), whichever is sooner; within 48 hours (weekends and holidays excluded) of a written request
laid_off: by the next regular payday or within 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded), whichever is sooner; within 48 hours (weekends and holidays excluded) of a written request
quit: by the next regular payday or within 10 days (weekends and holidays excluded), whichever is sooner; within 48 hours (weekends and holidays excluded) of a written request
late_penalty: administrative penalties of up to $750 ($500 if paid before the department files a state lien)

name: Illinois
fired: by the next regular payday
laid_off: by the next regular payday
quit: by the next regular payday

name: Iowa
fired: by the next regular payday for the pay period in which the wages were earned
laid_off: by the next regular payday for the pay period in which the wages were earned
quit: by the next regular payday for the pay period in which the wages were earned

name: Kansas
fired: by the next regular payday on which the employee would have been paid
laid_off: by the next regular payday on which the employee would have been paid
quit: by the next regular payday on which the employee would have been paid
late_penalty: if willful, 1% of the unpaid wages for each day (except Sundays and legal holidays) after the eighth day, or 100% of the unpaid wages, whichever is less

name: Maine
fired: by the next established payday
laid_off: by the next established payday
quit: by the next established payday
late_penalty: in a court action, the unpaid wages plus twice the unpaid wages as liquidated damages, interest, costs and fees; also a fine of $100 to $500 per violation

name: Maryland
fired: on or before the day the wages would have been paid had employment continued
laid_off: on or before the day the wages would have been paid had employment continued
quit: on or before the day the wages would have been paid had employment continued

name: Minnesota
fired: immediately on the employee's written demand; in default 24 hours after it
laid_off: immediately on the employee's written demand; in default 24 hours after it
quit: by the first regular payday; if that is less than 5 days away, the second payday, but within 20 calendar days
late_penalty: average daily earnings for each day in default, up to 15 days

name: Montana
fired: immediately when separated for cause or laid off, unless a written personnel policy extends it to the next regular payday or 15 days, whichever is first
laid_off: immediately when separated for cause or laid off, unless a written personnel policy extends it to the next regular payday or 15 days, whichever is first
quit: by the next regular payday for the pay period, or 15 days, whichever is first
law: Mont. Code Ann. 39-3-205(2); Mont. Code Ann. 39-3-205(1)

name: New Jersey
fired: by the regular payday for the pay period in which employment ended
laid_off: by the regular payday for the pay period in which employment ended
quit: by the regular payday for the pay period in which employment ended

name: New York
fired: by the payday on which the next pay would have been due
laid_off: by the payday on which the next pay would have been due
quit: by the payday on which the next pay would have been due

name: North Carolina
fired: by the next regular payday
laid_off: by the next regular payday
quit: by the next regular payday

name: North Dakota
fired: at the regular payday for the periods worked
laid_off: at the regular payday for the periods worked
quit: at the regular payday for the periods worked
late_penalty: the agreed wage for each day in default, ending 30 days after the default

name: Oklahoma
fired: by the next scheduled payday
laid_off: by the next scheduled payday
quit: by the next scheduled payday

name: Oregon
fired: by the end of the next business day
laid_off: by the end of the next business day
quit: with at least 48 hours' notice (weekends and holidays not counted): on the last day, or the next business day if that is a weekend or holiday; with less: within 5 business days or by the next regular payday, whichever comes first
late_penalty: penalty wages of eight times the regular hourly rate for each day unpaid, up to 30 days; plus a possible $1,000 civil penalty for willful failure

name: Pennsylvania
fired: by the next regular payday on which the wages would otherwise be due
laid_off: by the next regular payday on which the wages would otherwise be due
quit: by the next regular payday on which the wages would otherwise be due
late_penalty: wages unpaid 30 days after the regular payday (with no good-faith dispute): liquidated damages of 25% of the wages due or $500, whichever is greater

name: South Carolina
fired: within 48 hours of separation or by the next regular payday, which may not be more than 30 days away
laid_off: within 48 hours of separation or by the next regular payday, which may not be more than 30 days away
quit: within 48 hours of separation or by the next regular payday, which may not be more than 30 days away
late_penalty: in a civil action, three times the unpaid wages, plus costs and attorney's fees

name: South Dakota
fired: by the next regular payday
laid_off: by the next regular payday
quit: by the next regular payday

name: Tennessee
fired: by the next regular payday or 21 days after separation, whichever is later
laid_off: by the next regular payday or 21 days after separation, whichever is later
quit: by the next regular payday or 21 days after separation, whichever is later

name: Texas
fired: by the sixth day after the discharge
laid_off: by the sixth day after the discharge
quit: by the next regularly scheduled payday
law: Tex. Lab. Code 61.014(a); Tex. Lab. Code 61.014(b)

name: Vermont
fired: within 72 hours of the discharge
laid_off: within 72 hours of the discharge
quit: on the regular payday, or the following Friday if there is none

name: Virginia
fired: on or before the payday the wages would have been paid had employment continued
laid_off: on or before the payday the wages would have been paid had employment continued
quit: on or before the payday the wages would have been paid had employment continued

name: Washington
fired: at the end of the established pay period
laid_off: at the end of the established pay period
quit: at the end of the established pay period

name: West Virginia
fired: by the next regular payday on which the wages would otherwise be due
laid_off: by the next regular payday on which the wages would otherwise be due
quit: by the next regular payday on which the wages would otherwise be due
late_penalty: the unpaid amount plus two times that amount as liquidated damages

name: Wyoming
fired: by the next regular payday
laid_off: by the next regular payday
quit: by the next regular payday
